title: Solar Eclipse Composite Shows 30‑Second Totality in Spain

scenes.text: A composite photo captures the 30‑second totality of Spain’s solar eclipse

scenes.label: 30‑SECOND TOTALITY
scenes.text: The total eclipse phase lasted exactly 30 seconds at the 0.5° latitude line

scenes.label: LERNMA RADIUS
scenes.text: The Moon’s apparent diameter was 1.4° during the event, slightly larger than the Sun’s

scenes.label: NIGHT SKY CHANGES
scenes.text: Observers noted stars brighten and the sky darkened to twilight within seconds
Follow for the science they never taught you.

description: A composite image from Lerma, Spain, showcases the brief 30‑second totality of the solar eclipse, revealing rapid changes in light and temperature. Follow for daily science!
